title: CareLine Service Plans Plan Fee Discount Rates
content:
Two discounts can reduce a plan fee in the CareLine Service Plans family. The new-customer discount reduces the first term's plan fee for a customer whose Ridgeline installation was completed within the new-customer window. The loyalty discount reduces a renewal plan fee once the plan has been held for the loyalty threshold of consecutive plan years. On every tier the two are never combined: at most one of the new-customer and loyalty discounts applies to a term.

| Tier | New-customer discount on the first term's plan fee | New-customer window after a Ridgeline installation completion date (calendar days) | Loyalty discount on a renewal plan fee | Consecutive plan years held before the loyalty discount applies | How the two discounts combine |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| On-Call Service Account | 0% (0.0) | 90 | 0% (0.0) | 3 | Never combined |
| CareLine Basic Plan | 50% (0.5) | 90 | 10% (0.1) | 3 | Never combined |
| CareLine Plus Plan | 50% (0.5) | 90 | 10% (0.1) | 3 | Never combined |
| CareLine Premier Plan | 50% (0.5) | 90 | 10% (0.1) | 3 | Never combined |
| CareLine Premier 3-Year Plan | 25% (0.25) | 90 | 10% (0.1) | 3 | Never combined |
| CareLine Estate Plan | 50% (0.5) | 90 | 10% (0.1) | 3 | Never combined |

### Rates applied to the plan fee alone (hypothetical arithmetic on the scheduled plan fees)

| Tier | Plan fee per term | Less the new-customer rate | Less the loyalty rate |
|---|---|---|---|
| CareLine Basic Plan | 129.00 | 50% of 129.00 off, leaving 64.50 | 10% of 129.00 off, leaving 116.10 |
| CareLine Premier 3-Year Plan | 669.00 | 25% of 669.00 off, leaving 501.75 | 10% of 669.00 off, leaving 602.10 |
| CareLine Estate Plan | 389.00 | 50% of 389.00 off, leaving 194.50 | 10% of 389.00 off, leaving 350.10 |

These rows show each rate acting on the scheduled fee by itself; a term receives at most one of the two.

### Points of reading

**Can a term carry both a new-customer and a loyalty discount on a CareLine plan?** No. The two discounts are never combined; at most one of them applies to a term.

**Does the On-Call Service Account earn either discount?** Both of its rates are 0%.
